headings.rationale: Provides a premium, architectural, and corporate identity suitable for high-end carpentry and architecture.

body.rationale: Clean geometric sans that ensures high readability on mobile screens during on-site usage.

data_and_measurements.rationale: Brings the 'High Tech' and technical precision (blueprint/CAD) aesthetic to the measurement fields.

colors.rationale: Tinted black background with warm undertones to pair perfectly with gold. Avoided pure #000000. Used light gold for buttons as requested.

buttons.classes: bg-[#F3E5AB]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#F3E5AB] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-none sm:rounded-sm shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]
buttons.rationale: User requested 'cor DOURADO CLARO com aspecto TRANSPARENTE na forma RETANGULAR com inscrição na cor PRETA'. The heavy blur ensures the black text remains readable over the transparent gold, giving a premium 'humanized' tech feel.

inputs.classes: bg-transparent border-b border-[#F3E5AB]/30 focus:border-[#D4AF37] text-white font-mono rounded-none
inputs.rationale: Gives a blueprint/technical drawing feel to the measurement inputs. Kept rectangular to match the architectural vibe.

hero_overlay.rationale: Keeps the background image barely visible to provide texture without distracting from the core tools.

home_screen.layout: Flex column, vertical stacking. Centered branding.
home_screen.branding: Top positioned 'TUDO MAIS FÁCIL' in Gold (#D4AF37), large uppercase font.
home_screen.spacing: Generous spacing. gap-6 between main action buttons. Button height min h-20 (p-6) for easy mobile tapping.

measurement_form.structure: Multi-step or Accordion-based layout to organize 24 inputs.
measurement_form.repeatable_fields: CRITICAL: The user must be able to click '+ Adicionar' to add multiple instances of doors, columns, windows, outlets etc. Use a dynamic array state.
measurement_form.ui_pattern: Dense layout within accordions. Use Shadcn Accordion. Minimalist styling, JS/JSX based components.

saved_walls_list.layout: Bento grid or dense list view.
saved_walls_list.item_format: 'Parede 01', 'Parede 02', etc. Include an 'Export to SketchUp (JSON)' action.

photo_capture.ui_pattern: Full-screen camera overlay or file input with a custom styled trigger. Must have a section showing the 'extracted dominant color' (mocked if necessary, but visually present).

background_texture.description: Sleek modern dark kitchen/cabinetry to be used as a heavily darkened background image to give contextual architectural mood.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No pure #000000. Use the tinted background #0A0A08.
Do not use default Shadcn border radiuses for buttons; force them to be strictly rectangular (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) as requested.
Do not center-align the app container globally. Align text to the left for data readability, center only for the Hero logo and primary Home action buttons.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='btn-create-wall').
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for technical, clean architectural iconography.
Provide animations: hover states on buttons must slightly increase brightness and scale (e.g., hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform). Do NOT use transition-all.
For form states, implement dynamic arrays cleanly to allow adding multiple item instances (e.g., multiple columns on one wall).

Implement the 'transparent light gold' button EXACTLY as specified using backdrop-blur and high-opacity rgba to respect the 'aspecto TRANSPARENTE' and 'DOURADO CLARO' user request while maintaining contrast for the black text.
Avoid generic 'SaaS blue' or gradients entirely. Stick strictly to the Dark + Gold palette to convey the premium architectural/high-tech aesthetic.
Use sonner for toast notifications when a wall is saved or data is exported.
Since the codebase is primarily JS/JSX, provide standard React functional components.
